scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @multi-agent/server" "npm run dev -w @multi-agent/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @multi-agent/server && npm run build -w @multi-agent/client
scripts.test: npm run test -w @multi-agent/server && npm run test -w @multi-agent/client
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w @multi-agent/server && npm run test:coverage -w @multi-agent/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @multi-agent/server && npm run typecheck -w @multi-agent/client && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json
scripts.e2e:smoke: playwright test m12-interactions.spec.ts m16-serial.spec.ts m31-canvas-interactions.spec.ts m79-social.spec.ts
scripts.avatar:preview: node -e "console.log('启动 npm run dev 后打开 http://localhost:5173/#/avatars')"
